fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole runabout boat with motor and trailer.
findings: Dull, flat gelcoat along the port and starboard hull sides with no reflection
Faded, chalky-looking gray and charcoal stripe bands along both sides of the hull
Grime and staining on the white hull near the bow and lower sides above the trailer bunks
Dull white deck and bow surfaces with little gloss
No interior shots shown, so the cockpit cannot be judged from the photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Forester Diva. The gelcoat and the gray stripe bands along the hull sides look pretty flat in the photos, and a gelcoat polish would bring back a lot of the shine. We do mobile pre-sale boat details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
